Description

Detached tmux observations and pure navigation.

LibTmux.Server acquires a Snapshot in IO. Every operation in this module reads owned Haskell values, including after the Server closes. Use ordinary lists, comprehensions and folds for application predicates.

Window and Pane are physical entities. A WindowLink identifies an observed sessionindexwindow binding; PaneOccurrence retains that context. paneOccurrences therefore preserves repeated appearances while panes lists each physical pane once.

References compare identity within one Server generation. A lookup reads the supplied snapshot, including a newer snapshot from that same Server. Independent Server scopes have different generations. Resolve an ID again with lookupPaneId when deliberately selecting a newly observed entity.

Observation fields are exported for record dot and local updates. Editing a record does not change a snapshot's indexes or establish provenance. LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture constructs validated offline snapshots; snapshotOrigin distinguishes them from observations acquired through IO.

Complete observations

data Snapshot Source #

Validated metadata, physical graph and attached-client observations. Construction checks every join and forces owned values. List processing and indexed lookup remain pure after the operational Server closes.

data ServerInfo Source #

Reported daemon metadata within one adopted generation. PID and start time are observations; they do not grant signal authority or durable identity.

Constructors

ServerInfo 

Fields

  • generation :: !Generation

    Connection identity shared by all references in this snapshot.

  • pid :: !Integer

    Positive daemon process ID reported by tmux.

  • startedAt :: !Integer

    Daemon start time in whole seconds since the Unix epoch.

  • version :: !TmuxVersion

    Stable release admitted by LibTmux.Version.

  • socketPath :: !PosixPath

    Reported endpoint path, preserved as POSIX bytes.

data SnapshotOrigin Source #

Where the validated values were obtained. A server capture does not establish current liveness. Offline namespaces carry no targeting authority.

data CaptureInterval Source #

Monotonic process-clock bounds around acquisition. These values describe an interval and do not promise an atomic observation or a wall-clock epoch.

data Pane Source #

Detached physical pane. Its window can appear in several session contexts; PaneOccurrence preserves an appearance without duplicating physical identity.

Constructors

Pane 

Fields

  • ref :: !PaneRef

    Pane identity in the observation's generation.

  • window :: !WindowRef

    Containing physical window, resolved against a snapshot.

    Nonnegative pane index within that window.

    Positive terminal width in cells.

  • height :: !Dimension

    Positive terminal height in cells.

  • active :: !Bool

    The window's active pane, rather than a separate client focus.

  • dead :: !Bool

    Whether tmux reports the pane process as dead.

  • title :: !Text

    Valid UTF-8 pane title reported by tmux.

  • currentCommand :: !PosixString

    Reported process name; tmux may normalize it.

    Endpoint data, without local path interpretation.

data Client Source #

A detached client observation, not an operational connection or live ref. The live profile lists attached clients; an offline value may be unattached.

data ClientAttachment Source #

An attachment contains this capture's values. It never resolves a retained client name against a later capture. The pane is the session window's global active pane, not an independent client focus; its link retains session context.

Constructors

ClientAttachment 

Fields

  • session :: !Session

    Captured attachment session.

  • window :: !Window

    Captured physical selected window.

  • pane :: !PaneOccurrence

    Selected pane with its session/window-link context.

data LookupError Source #

A reference that cannot resolve in the supplied immutable snapshot. Missing entities are distinct from a successfully observed empty relation.

Constructors

ForeignGeneration

The reference belongs to another connection generation.

MissingSession !SessionRef

No session with this identity was captured.

MissingWindow !WindowRef

No physical window with this identity was captured.

MissingPane !PaneRef

No physical pane with this identity was captured.

Lossless labels

data TmuxText Source #

A lossless reported label. Equality and ordering compare bytes. String literals use UTF-8; byte constructors also admit non-text data. Conversion functions are exposed in LibTmux.Snapshot.
